description: React component for displaying and managing installed OAuth applications in Mattermost, including secret handling, editing, deletion, and filtering.

classes.name: InstalledOAuthApp
classes.description: React component class for rendering an installed OAuth app with controls for secret management, editing, and deletion.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Checks if the OAuth app matches the provided filter string.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with a fake secret.

methods.name: handleShowClientSecret
methods.description: Replaces the fake secret with the actual client secret to display it.

methods.name: handleHideClientSecret
methods.description: Reverts the displayed secret back to the fake secret.

methods.name: handleRegenerate
methods.description: Calls the regenerate secret function and updates the display or error state.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Triggers the delete function for the OAuth app.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the OAuth app details, controls, and actions based on current state and props.
